title: EMI Plushie Searcher
description: This project acts as an EMI addon to filter search for cobblemon plushies based on generation, type etc.
body:
**EMI Plushie Searcher** is a lightweight, client-side utility mod that helps your inventory management by adding highlighting filters to EMI for any Cobblemon Plushie-related items!

**Features**

Simply double-click your EMI search bar (enabling the yellow highlight mode) and type any of the following tags to instantly highlight matching items in your chests:

- gen=[1-9] (e.g., gen=1 for Kanto Plushies)
- type=[type] (e.g., type=fire, type=dragon)
- legendary=true
- mythical=true
- pseudo=true (Highlights pseudo-legendaries like Dragonite or Metagross)
- starter=true (Highlights base starters and all of their evolutions!)
